RQ1.objective: Can the DSL represent required evolution families?
RQ1.decision: report representable families, compilation outcomes, unsupported constructs; no universal expressiveness claim

RQ2.design: four bounded contexts, five lifecycle mutants; labeled deterministic cases
RQ2.decision: all corrected bounded contexts pass; each negative mutant produces a trace; report unsafe acceptance counts

RQ3.design: five exact Ollama tags × eligible normal-action tasks × five seeds
RQ3.decision: critical failure is any independently unsafe generated proposal deployed; invalid syntax and refusal have separate denominators

RQ4.design: B0/B1/B2 admission-only and B3 sandbox; phase timings and cluster telemetry
RQ4.decision: report distributions and limits; admission-only timing is not equivalent end-to-end deployment overhead

RQ5.objective: Measure graph scaling and concurrent conflicts
RQ5.design: 10/100/500 components × chain/star/random × 1/2/4/8 conflicting approvals × five seeds (180 records); barrier-synchronized commits, one trusted shared-memory process
RQ5.decision: report latency, traced peak Python allocations, completion, quarantine size, and commit winners

qualification: at least three independent complete smoke runs per site; both models; manifest agreement; fully GPU resident; resumability and successful fetched artifact checks
full_run_gate: no ranking or full submission without real successful qualification, pinned model digests and a disjoint assignment
statistics: descriptive means/medians/SD, task-cluster bootstrap CI; paired task differences when same task/seed are observed; no significance claims from smoke or local validation

ablations.scope: synthetic sandbox gate removals with overlapping checks retained; see experiments/ABLATIONS.md
